label: Finite flywheel energy ledger over a fixed interval
note: Analyst energy accounting, not a definition of productive causation. Ledger before and after count the same identified flywheel kinetic-energy resource; input is boundary-crossing energy, work is selected load output, heat is remaining exported energy, all in one unit and interval. Admissible explicitly stipulates nonnegative fields and after + work + heat = before + input. Work and heat are flows integrated over an interval, before and after stocks. No causal, modal, existence or well-foundedness predicate is defined. Resource identity, boundary completeness, physical dynamics and applicability to ACT-POWER remain OPEN; see docs/notes/productive-store-1378.md.
